```{r 1}

rm(list = ls())

knit_start_time <- Sys.time()

source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  nhdplusTools,
  sf,
  tidyverse,
  viridis
)

theme_set(theme_void())

dir_data <- "../data/processed"
dir_figs <- "../figures"

huc_level <- "huc08"
huc_col <- str_replace(huc_level, "huc0", "huc")

path_metrics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_allometry_metrics.csv"))
path_diagnostics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_diagnostics.csv"))
path_flowlines <- file.path(dir_data, "riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp")

```


```{r 2}

metrics <- read_csv(path_metrics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"),
    metabolism = recode(
      metabolism_var,
      c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER"
    )
  )

diagnostics <- read_csv(path_diagnostics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"))

annual_metrics <- metrics |>
  inner_join(diagnostics, by = c("huc_level", "huc")) |>
  filter(
    n >= 30,
    is.finite(slope),
    is.finite(r2)
  ) |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    annual_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_r2 = median(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_months >= 6) |>
  mutate(
    slope_class = case_when(
      annual_slope < 0.8 ~ "Sublinear",
      annual_slope <= 1.2 ~ "Linear",
      annual_slope > 1.2 ~ "Superlinear"
    ),
    slope_class = factor(slope_class, levels = c("Sublinear", "Linear", "Superlinear")),
    coherence_class = if_else(annual_r2 >= 0.8, "Coherent", "Not coherent"),
    coherence_class = factor(coherence_class, levels = c("Not coherent", "Coherent"))
  )

```


```{r 3}

flowlines_sf <- read_sf(path_flowlines) |>
  clean_names()

huc_boundaries <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
  AOI = st_as_sfc(st_bbox(flowlines_sf)),
  type = huc_level,
  t_srs = 4326
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(.data[[huc_col]]), width = 8, pad = "0"))

```


```{r 4}

plot_huc_map <- function(data, fill_var, title, fill_label, palette_values) {
  
  huc_boundaries |>
    left_join(data, by = "huc") |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = {{ fill_var }}), color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = palette_values,
      na.value = "grey82",
      name = fill_label
    ) +
    coord_sf(datum = NA) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

```


```{r 5}

p_gpp_slope_map <- annual_metrics |>
  filter(metabolism == "GPP") |>
  plot_huc_map(
    fill_var = slope_class,
    title = "Annual GPP allometric scaling class",
    fill_label = "GPP slope",
    palette_values = c(
      "Sublinear" = "#2166ac",
      "Linear" = "orange",
      "Superlinear" = "#b2182b"
    )
  )

p_gpp_slope_map

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "07b_gpp_slope_class_huc08_map.png"),
  p_gpp_slope_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```
